newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African business seeks interdict against strike.
newsitem.headline: S.African business seeks interdict against strike.

text.p: The Business South Africa (BSA) employers' group on Monday served legal papers on the country's biggest trade union federation in a bid to prevent a planned general strike on May 12 over employment legislation.
The Congress of South African Trade Unions (Cosatu) said the papers claimed proper notice of the action had not been given, a charge Cosatu denied.
"Cosatu is convinced...that we followed the necessary procedures," a statement from the union grouping said.

"From our side, we are more determined than ever that the action will continue. We are calling on our members to redouble their efforts. Marches and rallies will take place throughout the country from 12h00 (1000 GMT) on Monday May 12."
